driving_video.title: Driving Video
driving_video.description: A video to drive the animation

video_frame_load_cap.title: Video Frame Load Cap
video_frame_load_cap.description: The maximum number of frames to load from the driving video. Set to 0 to use all frames.

video_select_every_n_frames.title: Video Select Every N Frames
video_select_every_n_frames.description: Select every nth frame from the driving video. Set to 1 to use all frames.

input.prompt: Upbeat pop punk songs for the morning

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Seed for random number generator. If None or -1, a random seed will be used.

top_k.title: Top K
top_k.description: Reduces sampling to the k most likely tokens.

top_p.title: Top P
top_p.description: Reduces sampling to tokens with cumulative probability of p. When set to  `0` (default), top_k sampling is used.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: A description of the music you want to generate.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Duration of the generated audio in seconds.

input_audio.title: Input Audio
input_audio.description: An audio file that will influence the generated music. If `continuation` is `True`, the generated music will be a continuation of the audio file. Otherwise, the generated music will mimic the audio file's melody.

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: Controls the 'conservativeness' of the sampling process. Higher temperature means more diversity.

continuation.title: Continuation
continuation.description: If `True`, generated music will continue `melody`. Otherwise, generated music will mimic `audio_input`'s melody.

continuation_end.title: Continuation End
continuation_end.description: End time of the audio file to use for continuation. If -1 or None, will default to the end of the audio clip.

replicate_weights.title: Replicate Weights
replicate_weights.description: Replicate MusicGen weights to use. Leave blank to use the default weights.

continuation_start.title: Continuation Start
continuation_start.description: Start time of the audio file to use for continuation.

multi_band_diffusion.title: Multi Band Diffusion
multi_band_diffusion.description: If `True`, the EnCodec tokens will be decoded with MultiBand Diffusion. Only works with non-stereo models.

classifier_free_guidance.title: Classifier Free Guidance
classifier_free_guidance.description: Increases the influence of inputs on the output. Higher values produce lower-varience outputs that adhere more closely to inputs.

epochs.title: Epochs
epochs.description: Number of epochs to train for

batch_size.title: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Batch size. Must be multiple of 8(number of gpus), for 8-gpu training.

drop_vocals.title: Drop Vocals
drop_vocals.description: Dropping the vocal tracks from the audio files in dataset, by separating sources with Demucs.

dataset_path.title: Dataset Path
dataset_path.default: Path to dataset directory. Input audio files will be chunked into multiple 30 second audio files. Must be one of 'tar', 'tar.gz', 'gz', 'zip' types of compressed file, or a single 'wav', 'mp3', 'flac' file. Audio files must be longer than 5 seconds.

auto_labeling.title: Auto Labeling
auto_labeling.description: Creating label data like genre, mood, theme, instrumentation, key, bpm for each track. Using `essentia-tensorflow` for music information retrieval.

checkpoint_folder.title: Checkpoint Folder
checkpoint_folder.description: Name of the folder containing checkpoint to continue training from

updates_per_epoch.title: Updates Per Epoch
updates_per_epoch.description: Number of iterations for one epoch

one_same_description.title: One Same Description
one_same_description.description: A description for all of audio data
